en: You know Alexei?
Course I do! Been helping out the Church since he was a baby! Taught him some prayers meself! And has he a single word of gratitude for me? No, not that I can hear...
But Jesus is with him for sure, I can see it in his eyes. He often comes for a chat when work allows: about God, about the East... Keeps an old hag like me a bit of company, bless his soul.
What do you do around here?
I'm the chef! I prepare all sorts of meals for folks, especially those that we, the Acolytes, help.
Some recipes are from this area, but frankly, they're mostly dreadful. My favorites are the ones I remember from the East...
Of course, everything is made worse when you have to use Mutant meat!... So I avoid that, when I can.
You're from the East?
Oh, let that slip out, did I... Wrinkly old brain...  Keep it between us, wouldn't you. Too many distrustful eyes as is...

Yes, I was born East of here – can't remember the name of the place... Not sure it really had a name. It was a ghost shaped like land – in my mind, it's just a flash of gray prairies and visions of farm work.
My dad's rusty tools and some ugly, brown-green grass... That's all that's left of the East in this old noggin'. Maybe the Mist took all else away. Maybe there was never anything there.
Tell me more about the East.
I can certainly try.
Tell me more about your job.
Oh, dear. A Vulture who wants to learn how to cook?
Got to get going, now.
How do you get ingredients?
My dear, being an Acolyte and having connections to the Rada makes things quite easy sometimes. Suppose Vultures can't really grasp the idea of a "business network" so good.
I get my meat from Bogdan, the butcher. He's with the Rada. The vegetables I get from Jasna, the farmer. She is with us Acolytes.
Sometimes I hire Vultures to bring me extra things that I need... So if you're interested in some work, do come by.
Don't the radiation and Mist poison everything?
Well, there are ways to make the contaminated stuff edible. Even Mutant meat can be nutritious and, as far as we know, harmless – long as you cook it right.

Of course, for stuff like vegetables and water you'll need the filters invented by those stuck-up Mechanists – otherwise, you'll lay sick after every meal!... Which I imagine is a common feeling for your kind...
Do you sell all the food you make?
Nah, only a portion of it. Most of what I make goes to Acolytes and our charity work, help the starving mouths of Zalesye 'n all that.
'Fraid you don't qualify for such donations, my dear. You have the means to buy weapons and armor, so food should not be given to you freely.
Let me ask about other things.
I have to leave.
Was it peaceful, like the tales?
Most surely the tales speak of somewhere even further East, much further, too distant from my old place to affect me in any way... Such is my burden, that no one believes me when I say that.

But yes – there was a lotta toil, but... It seemed like a peaceful place. But remember: we left 'cause we were fleein' the Mist, and the Violence. There was another war that folks 'round here seem to have forgot all about. Misplaced in their collective knowledge of history.
Something tore away the peace just like it did in the West.
Why do folks not believe you?
To most Commonfolk, I'm too suspicious. A foreign woman, trying to make it in Zalesye even though she's from the Promised Land? Well, she ain't deserve no trust.
How could she choose this dump over Wyraj? From such an idyllic place to the heart of the bends? And this lady cooks our food?
It don't take much to be rejected by a community you weren't born into, I'm afraid. Thankfully... I have the Church. The house of God is most welcomin'.
Was it truly free of radiation and Mist?
No. We fled from those things, just like you Westerners did.
Why not flee Eastward, then?
There was a Violence going on; I won't be mad if you don't believe me, but... Yeah, another war, apart from the main conflict between us and the West.
Seems the people of Rhos were fighting themselves, brother versus brother, and it got bloody enough that the West with its higher spread of Mist still seemed preferable...
Tell me more about the Eastern War.
Are you sure? I have nothing but a hazy memory of third-hand accounts.
About something else.
I'll see you later.
What was the conflict about?
Most certainly on account of the main War, y'know? With the West.
Internal tensions between pro- and anti-government groups... In short, a civil war.
Fightin' for control over our future as a nation: rebellion and continued struggle against the West, or submission to the imperialists as a way to end the carnage...
Is that really worth warring over?
How else do you resolve this kinda thing? One day we'll see the same cycles of destruction here, in Zalesye; maybe not in my time, but still...
Violence 'tween Gunners and Palatines, Rada actin' all mighty, religious fervor which even as an Acolyte, I must say – can be corrupted, exploited...
One day, folks we've known for years will take up arms, and they might be on a different side than ours. And we'll all be right bastards.
Until then, we do what we can.
Is the war over?
Who knows? Been so, so long – surely there's a winner by now?

But then again, maybe it's a still-living reason for us to know next to nothing about the East. If a civil war is still on, surely it blocks our way into this Wyraj, and Wyraj's way to us. And makes whatever's in-between into Hell.

By the way – I've heard a mighty scavenger's come in from the RO-29 highway recently. Scary, tough, with some next-level weapons. Maybe it's a harsher environment than this which produces these kinda folk – them who truly thrive in violence.
Changing the subject.
Gotta go.

Back from a scavenge?
What do you need?
Wanna talk.
Let's talk a bit.
Got some questions.
I need some food.

Need food – what do you have?
Let me show you what I've been cooking.

Come back later.
Keep yourself nourished.
Take care with your nutrition.
Bye, dear.
I'll find what you need.

I'll think about it.

I'll get some medicine, then.

Yes,  these will do great. Thank you!
Ah, just what I needed. Now for my end of the deal.
Nice! These will help me with the next batch. Here you go.
Some of the Commonfolk are getting dysentery from rotten ingredients in their food. We’re feeding them better now, but still need some medicine... Got anything?
I think the last batch of food we made had spoiled meat in it – folks’ve been getting sick. Help us find some medicine and I’ll reward you.
Oh, you're a lifesaver. These will help a lot. Here you go...
These will do wonderfully. Here's your reward!
Thank you, these are just what I needed. Your reward...

Sumthin' about it bein'... Violent? The soldiers who came mighta blocked the way, and Zalesye was the only option. It's just like them Gunners and Bandits blockin' our roads!
Seems the people of Rhos got a knack for gunnin' down their brothers and sisters. No wonder some folk think we should just surrender to the Mist...
About that conflict near your hometown.
You sure? Got nothing but some hazy old memories.
About something else.
I'll see you later.
What was the conflict about?
Most certainly on account of the main War, y'know? With the West.
They called it an insurgency, but I don't know what that meant back then. Ain't like the West had invaded us or nothin', right...?

I just remember different colors on different soldiers, and the stripes were different, too. Some of 'em looked nothin' like any of us here in Rhos... Wonder if the imperialists came all the way over here.
... "Imperialists"?
Oh, y'know. Heard the term thrown around a bunch when I was a youngin'. Folks from the West, basically, that's what they called 'em.
Y'know, maybe it weren't no different from what we got now. Violence 'tween Gunners and Palatines, Bandits runnin' loose, no one even knows who they are.
Folks we've known for years can just decide to join them bastards, and now they're suddenly on a different side of the Bastion. And we'll have a war of our own. Ain't it so?
Until then, we do what we can.
Is the war over?
Who knows? Been so, so long – surely there's a winner by now?
Then again, maybe it's a still-livin' reason for us to know next to nothin' 'bout the East. Would be blockin' our way into Wyraj, and Wyraj's way to us. And whatever's in-between becomes Hell.
And now, apparently there's all sortsa super soldiers comin' in to whack you Vultures bloody. Please don't get yourself involved in the next war, dear, and stop worryin' 'bout the East so much.

Gotta go.

You should've stayed there, I think.
